ov: صيف حلق الوادي (الفرنسية: Un été à La Goulette) فلم تونسي فرنسي من إنتاج عام 1996 وهو ثاني فلم روائي طويل للمخرج فريد بوغدير.
plotEn: Youssef (Mustapha Adouani) is a Muslim who works on the TGM and lives in La Goulette. His best friends are Jewish Jojo the brik seller and Sicilian Catholic Giuseppe the fisherman, who are also his neighbours. Their daughters grow up together and share their prospects for life, but the landlord Hadj Beji (Gamil Ratib) has his eyes on Youssef's daughter Meriem (Sonia Mankaï).
